source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the C3A4 unit test (core-ar2 0.3), recorded in rytm2_mods euclid-accents/README.md at afd461d; and the SXH4 bench runs on the same unit (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25); and the solo bench run of EAH4 on the same unit (2026-10-25)
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74, 2026-10-20, C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports): euclid-accents 1.1's test steps 1 to 4 pass. OP turns past SUB to OR*, XOR*, AND* and SUB*; with OR* only grid trigs play and those on euclid hits are accented; FUNC + EUC off writes the accents into the pattern; with an accent operator EUC stays on and the track plays only its grid trigs, and a plain operator brings euclid's trigs back. OP keeps its accent value through a power-cycle without SAVE PROJECT. On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24/25) only the grid trigs played at XOR* and SUB*, those on euclid hits measured 2.1-2.4 dB louder, and OP kept SUB* through a power cycle without SAVE PROJECT. Alone on EAH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) only the grid trigs played at XOR* and SUB* and those on euclid hits measured 2.0-2.3 dB louder.
scope: euclid-accents 1.1 beside other rytm2_mods ports. SXH4 ran it with the released core-ar2 0.3 and the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions. EAH4 ran it alone with the released core-ar2 0.3.

builds.label: EAH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and this module's rytm2_mods v1.2 release object as the only module, plus the remote-control test layer (analoghealth 1.2, no site shared with core or the module). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: Alone: at XOR* and SUB* only grid trigs play; those on euclid hits peak 2.0-2.3 dB higher (measured).
No freeze or dropout on any output.

builds.label: SXH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and rytm2_mods v1.2's release objects for the six Modwerk 1.74 submissions, plus a remote-control test layer (three sites, none shared with core or the modules). Without the test layer the same inputs give SX74 (2a352718de044cdba51a2b8a3a064ef126d79ab54f24ac7a7662f6c686e64371). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after each run.
results: SXH4: at XOR* and SUB* only grid trigs play; those on euclid hits peak 2.1-2.4 dB higher (measured).
SXH4: OP kept SUB* through a power cycle without SAVE PROJECT.

Four minutes of play with samples, delay and reverb sends and knob turns: no freeze, gap or level dip on any output; clicks on the main mix also appear on the same core and test layer without the modules.

builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
